actions.body: The synthesis of recent source material indicates that automated axiom discovery is a viable mechanism for surfacing implicit structural assumptions in intelligent reasoning frameworks. By utilizing complex network analysis, WAKE can detect phase transitions that correspond to potential model failures or shifts in operational context. This approach bridges the gap between raw data interpretation and the identification of foundational epistemic biases. Future work must integrate these detections with explicit self-correction protocols.
